title: WP900 G9 must not compose G8 independent-source runtime evidence across a changed exact source subject without invariance or same-subject re-execution
target: F2-WP-900 generation 9 semantic content causality target-runtime promotion

material_observation.g8_scope: G8 independently executed source-range readback on owner-VPS clay-direct-dev and contradicted caller omission for the matching arm; its no-match arm did not prove negative causal authority.
material_observation.g9_source_change: G9 owns a new semantic-content crossover implementation path and therefore will create a successor exact source subject before any promotion-bearing target execution.
material_observation.risk: A later green G9 target run cannot silently inherit G8 independent-source/runtime provenance merely because G9 descends from G8. Old runtime evidence plus new source is not current-subject runtime evidence unless the relevant boundary is explicitly proven invariant or the discriminator is re-executed on the exact G9 subject.

falsifier_hypothesis: If G9 target execution cites G8's old independent-source receipt while the exact G9 source subject differs and no admitted invariance or same-subject independent-source discriminator exists, any broader semantic GWT/J-Space promotion is cross-generation evidence composition without current-subject runtime authority.

counterexample.setup: G9 adds or changes semantic-content crossover/source wiring, freezes a new source SHA and executes the four-trial semantic crossover successfully. The acceptance narrative then combines that new run with G8 run 33579722705 to assert independent upstream source provenance, even though the G8 discriminator executed only subject e811c3ab08c21a641c9a7a07ec7827092be46a16 and the current G9 source/event path was never independently re-read or proven invariant.

acceptance_paths: Preferred: on the frozen exact G9 promotion subject, execute an admitted independent-source/source-range discriminator that re-establishes the provenance property needed by G9, and bind its receipt to the same source/tree/runtime subject as the semantic-content crossover.

Alternative only if current authority admits it: produce an explicit RUNTIME_SUBJECT_INVARIANT proof naming the exact G8 semantic boundary reused by G9, proving the relevant source/event-classification/admission path is byte-identical or otherwise causally invariant across subjects, and bind that proof into reconciliation before composing evidence.
hard_negatives: same runner, controller, boot class or environment is not exact-source invariance
green repository CI on G9 does not transfer G8 target-runtime provenance
a descendant commit relation does not prove the G8 observed boundary is unchanged
a G9 target crossover that validates DELIVERY/UPTAKE/REENTRY internally does not automatically prove the separate G8 independent upstream source-range property
G8 singleton dispatch is consumed; do not redispatch G8 generation 8 as if it were still active. Any re-execution must be a G9/current-subject discriminator bound to the new exact subject.
if source/event/admission semantics changed across G8 and G9, classify invariance as false and require exact current-subject execution rather than narrative composition
promotion_rule: Until same-subject independent-source evidence or an admitted explicit invariance proof exists, G9 may earn only its own exact semantic-content crossover candidate scope. semantic_gwt_runtime_credit, jspace_runtime_credit and any broader GWT causal authority remain zero.
next_exact_action: Do not mutate G9 from this reviewer lane. Before any promotion-bearing G9 target dispatch, the active owner should freeze the exact G9 source/tree and either co-execute a current-subject independent-source readback discriminator or bind an admitted explicit runtime-subject invariance proof. Preserve G8 as terminal historical exact-scope evidence and preserve semantic GWT/J-Space credit at zero until this fence is satisfied.
